core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide Price £285,000, freehold, no onward chain. The property has gas central heating with a Worcester boiler installed in 2019.

The ground floor comprises a lounge measuring 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). There is a lean-to utility. The first floor has bedroom one measuring 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two measuring 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"), and bedroom three measuring 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approx. 9m (30ft) and has a gate to the shared rear path. Parking is on-street with no permit required.

Fernhill Close is in Lordswood, Chatham, Kent ME5.

Guide Price £285,000, freehold, Council Tax Band B (Medway Council), EPC rating C. Construction: standard – brick under a concrete tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage, gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
core.summary: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Lordswood with gas central heating, Worcester boiler 2019, rear garden with gate to shared rear path, and on-street parking. Guide Price £285,000, freehold, no onward chain.
